materialFacts: The program is for private properties in Surrey and Surrey residents.
The purchasing card must use a Surrey billing name and address; purchases using an outside-Surrey billing address are cancelled.
The eligibility section says a maximum of two trees per Surrey address, based on the billing address.
The tree-list section says two trees per household. This sentence is newly itemized at 12:30 and was not itemized in the 10:30 extract, so it is not certified as unchanged against that artifact.
All trees cost $20; most are in 3- or 5-gallon pots and are 5 to 12 feet tall.
The Aug. 18 online store runs from 9 a.m. to Sept. 1 while supplies last, with pickup Sept. 13.
The Sept. 29 online store runs from 9 a.m. to Oct. 13 while supplies last, with pickup Oct. 25.
Pickup is at the Surrey Operations Centre, 6651 148 Street, and buyers select a pickup time at checkout.
Items in a cart are not held until payment has been processed.
Each sale has approximately 1,000 trees available first come, first served.
